name: Recital E
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming European Research Area (ERA) Act
part_text: whereas the ERA Policy Agenda serves as a valuable non-binding framework guiding national and EU-level policies in line with the objectives of Article 179 TFEU, promoting voluntary coordination and cooperation between Member States and the Union; whereas these objectives must be complemented by provisions and incentives under the future ERA Act, and tools such as the European Semester, to provide a stronger foundation for a coherent and high-performing ERA;
